vocabulary_groups.title: Fashion student identity
vocabulary_groups.description: Core words for introducing yourself as a Fashion Design student.

items.definition_en: The field of creating clothing, accessories, and fashion concepts.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The subject students study when they learn to create fashion products and ideas.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: A area de estudo em que os alunos aprendem a criar roupas, acessorios e ideias de moda.
items.example_sentence_en: I study fashion design at university.
items.example_sentence_pt: Eu estudo design de moda na universidade.
items.professional_context_en: Students use this term to describe their degree, coursework, and professional focus.
items.professional_context_pt: Os alunos usam esse termo para descrever seu curso, suas disciplinas e seu foco profissional.
items.translation_notes_pt: A traducao mais natural e 'design de moda'.
items.pronunciation_notes: Say FASH-un de-ZINE with clear stress on the second word.

items.definition_en: A quick drawing that shows a fashion idea.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A simple drawing of a clothing idea.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Um desenho simples de uma ideia de roupa.
items.example_sentence_en: This is my first sketch for class.
items.example_sentence_pt: Este e o meu primeiro croqui para a aula.
items.professional_context_en: Fashion students often present sketches before making garments.
items.professional_context_pt: Estudantes de moda costumam apresentar croquis antes de confeccionar pecas.
items.translation_notes_pt: Em contexto de moda, 'sketch' pode ser traduzido como 'croqui' ou 'esboco'.
items.pronunciation_notes: The final sound is short and clear: sketch.

items.definition_en: A collection of work that shows a student's or designer's skills.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: A group of texts, images, or projects that shows what you can do.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Um conjunto de textos, imagens ou projetos que mostra o que voce sabe fazer.
items.example_sentence_en: I want to write better texts for my portfolio.
items.example_sentence_pt: Eu quero escrever textos melhores para o meu portfolio.
items.professional_context_en: A portfolio helps Fashion Design students present work to teachers, internships, and future employers.
items.professional_context_pt: O portfolio ajuda estudantes de moda a apresentar trabalhos para professores, estagios e futuros empregadores.
items.translation_notes_pt: Muitos cursos usam a forma 'portfolio' no uso cotidiano.
items.pronunciation_notes: Say port-FOH-lee-oh with stress on FOH.

vocabulary_groups.title: Course routine and studio language
vocabulary_groups.description: Useful verbs and nouns for the weekly ESP workflow.

items.learner_friendly_definition_en: The cloth used to make a garment.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: O tecido usado para fazer uma peca de roupa.
items.example_sentence_en: I like working with fabric in sewing class.
items.example_sentence_pt: Eu gosto de trabalhar com tecido na aula de costura.
items.professional_context_en: Fabric vocabulary appears often in studio classes, design descriptions, and portfolio work.
items.professional_context_pt: O vocabulario de tecidos aparece com frequencia em aulas de atelie, descricoes de design e portfolio.
items.translation_notes_pt: A traducao direta mais comum e 'tecido'.

items.definition_en: To send your work for review.
items.learner_friendly_definition_en: To send your answer or task to the teacher or platform.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Enviar sua resposta ou atividade para o professor ou para a plataforma.
items.example_sentence_en: Please submit your profile after you review it.
items.example_sentence_pt: Por favor, envie o seu perfil depois de revisa-lo.
items.professional_context_en: Students need this verb for assignments, drafts, and portfolio tasks.
items.professional_context_pt: Os alunos precisam desse verbo para tarefas, rascunhos e atividades de portfolio.
items.translation_notes_pt: Pode ser traduzido como 'enviar' ou 'submeter', dependendo do contexto.
items.pronunciation_notes: The stress is on the second syllable: sub-MIT.

items.learner_friendly_definition_en: Helpful comments about what is working and what to improve.
items.learner_friendly_definition_pt: Comentarios uteis sobre o que esta funcionando e o que melhorar.
items.example_sentence_en: I read the feedback and improve one sentence.
items.example_sentence_pt: Eu leio o feedback e melhoro uma frase.
items.professional_context_en: Feedback is central in critiques, writing revision, and teacher review.
items.professional_context_pt: O feedback e central em criticas, revisao de escrita e avaliacao do professor.
items.translation_notes_pt: Muitos professores usam 'feedback' diretamente, mas 'devolutiva' tambem pode aparecer.
items.pronunciation_notes: Say FEED-back with stress on FEED.
